question: When does the DJI Matrice 4T start Failsafe RTH after losing the remote controller signal?

intake.focus: Matrice 4T lost RC signal failsafe RTH timing
intake.reason: Question asks for guidance on lost-link behavior and RTH triggers in DJI Matrice 4T manuals.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance claims: when a hazard occurs, reestablish the control link; if the link cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. The manuals claim: the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH when the remote controller signal is lost and the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH. Incident reports are unverified accounts with no usable evidence in the approved collection. The main gap/conflict is whether Failsafe RTH auto-activates on RC loss (DJI claim) versus FAA guidance that emphasizes manual emergency procedures if the link cannot be reestablished.
